jobs.title: Tutor
jobs.reason: This is a client-training tutor / assessor contract role based in Shanghai, entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and geopolitical-risk zones, and almost certainly requiring Mandarin and specialist assurance/training expertise the candidate lacks. It offers no paper fit or interest alignment and is not a realistic target.

jobs.title: Contractor - IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: A "Lead Auditor" role requiring deep specialist expertise in automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, AIAG core tools, OEM requirements) — this is neither entry-level nor within the candidate's competence, and the seniority/experience bar is a hard mismatch. It also sits entirely outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it is a speculative/expert-appointment posting with no clear salaried vacancy, and it seeks established specialists rather than an early-career candidate. Although human rights and securitisation are core-interest topics, the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: it is a "Manager"-level B2B sales role requiring at least 2 years of demonstrable sales-target experience the candidate lacks, and it requires fluency in a business language of the base region (Chinese) beyond German/English. Account management and revenue-driven sales are also outside the candidate's research/policy profile and interests.

jobs.title: Junior Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a junior compliance auditor / assessor role (training toward CSCA certification) in supply-chain assurance — it does not require prior qualifications the candidate lacks, so it clears the eligibility gate, but it is a poor paper fit for a research- and policy-oriented profile with no auditing background. The field sits entirely outside the candidate's three interest zones, and the certification-and-retention structure signals an operational assurance career, not policy or intelligence research.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a senior, deep-technical software-engineering role whose essential requirements (extensive experience building scalable systems, AWS cloud architecture, IaC, CI/CD, production data pipelines) are far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python — a hard ML/software-engineering disqualifier. The "Senior" title and demand for extensive experience also fail the entry-level gate. Location is London, but that is irrelevant given the hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Assistant Programme Manager - A Fairer Start
jobs.reason: This is an administrative / project-coordination role rather than a research or analysis post; the candidate's project-administration experience at the German Rectors' Conference is relevant, but the emphasis on programme-management skills and coordinating others is a partial fit and not the candidate's strongest offering. The child-disadvantage / social-innovation subject sits outside all three core interest zones, so interest pull is low. Eligible and London-based, but a weak overall match.

jobs.title: Advocacy Officer (maternity cover)
jobs.reason: The role sits squarely in the candidate's core mission (human rights, survivor advocacy, Magnitsky sanctions) and the "intermediate professional with some previous experience" ask is a soft obstacle rather than a disqualifier, though the candidate's advocacy-campaign experience is thin. Strong interest fit and the research/writing transfers, but the advocacy-specialist focus and requested prior experience temper the score to a solid, realistic application.
jobs.type: Part-time (3 days a week), Fixed term 12 months

jobs.title: Student and Academic Support Officer - (0.4 FTE)
jobs.reason: This is a genuine entry-level administrative role the candidate can perform — their project-administration and stakeholder-liaison work at the German Rectors' Conference fit well, and no experience is essential. However, it is pure student-support administration with no research or policy content and sits outside all three interest zones, so it lands as a marginal eligible option despite the strong administrative match.

jobs.title: Student and Academic Support Officer - (1.0 FTE)

The role is also purely commercial subscription-performance analytics, well outside all interest zones.

It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interest zones.

It sits within the academic/policy interest zone and is highly winnable given the candidate's strong research and writing background; the only drag is that teaching-fellow work is somewhat tangential to the candidate's core analyst/research career trajectory.

The main soft obstacle is that GTA roles usually expect some prior tutorial-teaching experience, which the candidate lacks, and the hourly casual nature makes it a side-role rather than a primary target; still, it sits squarely in the core academic zone and is a realistic, winnable London application.
